items.reason: Gap 1 describes two concurrent in-flight retries both missing the set and both running the handler before either id is inserted.
Gap 2 describes a delivery whose X-Event-Id differs from the signed body id, i.e. a header changed on a validly signed body.
Gap 0 says charge.refunded matches no handler because only refund.created is registered.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; the concurrency gap concerns jobs within one queue.
